markets.question: BNB Up or Down on September 10?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Up" if the "Close" price for the Binance 1 minute candle for BNB/USDT Sep 9 '26 12:00 in the ET timezone (noon) is lower than the final "Close" price for the Sep 10 '26 12:00 ET candle.

This market will resolve to "Down" if the "Close" price for the Binance 1 minute candle for BNB/USDT Sep 9 '26 12:00 in the ET timezone (noon) is higher than the final "Close" price for the Sep 10 '26 12:00 ET candle.

If the final "Close" price for both of these candles is exactly equal on Binance, this market will resolve 50-50.

The resolution source for this market is Binance, specifically the BNB/USDT "Close" prices currently available at https://www.binance.com/en/trade/BNB_USDT with "1m" and "Candles" selected on the top bar.

Please note that this market is about the price according to Binance BNB/USDT, not according to other exchanges or trading pairs.
